text: Qwen Token Plan usage 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的用量面板，在「设置 → 模型」页脚显示 Qwen Cloud Token Plan 状态与用量。用户可通过独立 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口登录，也可提交浏览器 Cookie；插件读取套餐订阅、配额及使用百分比，展示月度、每周和五小时用量，并提供刷新、取消登录和退出操作。适合需要在 DSH 查看 Qwen 套餐剩余用量的用户。需要 Qwen Cloud Token Plan 账号及登录会话 Cookie；用量查询连接 Qwen Cloud 服务。

Qwen Token Plan usage adds a panel to DSH Web’s Models settings page. It displays monthly, weekly, and five-hour Qwen plan usage. Sign in through Edge or Chrome, then refresh or sign out from the panel. A Qwen Cloud account and session cookie are required.
想在 DSH 的模型设置页看 Qwen 套餐还剩多少用量。
DSH 能不能显示 Qwen Token Plan 的月度和短周期用量？
I want to check my Qwen plan usage from the DSH models settings page.
Qwen Token Plan usage 的用量面板：在 DSH「设置 → 模型」页脚展示套餐状态、月度/每周/五小时用量比例及可用的重置时间；面板可手动刷新。
Qwen Token Plan usage 的登录连接：点击登录后打开独立 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口，读取 Qwen Cloud 登录 Cookie 并保存会话；也支持粘贴 Cookie，用户可取消登录或退出连接。
用量请求会携带 Qwen 登录 Cookie 访问 home.qwencloud.com 和 cs-data.qwencloud.com；推理 API Key 本身不能读取套餐用量。

@local/dsh-qwen-plan-usage README · Qwen Token Plan usage for DeepSeek Harness：The inference API key cannot read plan quota. Sign-in opens a dedicated Edge or Chrome window, not your everyday browser. After you sign in, the plugin reads only `qwencloud.com` cookies and shows the quota Qwen actually returns: monthly, 5-hour, and weekly figures appear only when that field is present.

This is an unofficial plugin. It is not affiliated with Alibaba, Qwen, or DeepSeek. The usage endpoints are undocumented console APIs and can change.
section: Qwen Token Plan usage for DeepSeek Harness

@local/dsh-qwen-plan-usage README · Install：From a DSH session, ask the agent to install this repository, or run:

```text
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:alvinlui-hk/dsh-qwen-plan-usage
```

That command needs `git` on `PATH`. If `git` is not installed, use the tarball instead. It does not need Git:

```text
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/alvinlui-hk/dsh-qwen-plan-usage/tar.gz/refs/heads/main
```

Use `--profile web` instead of `--profile desktop` if that is the profile with the Web UI.
@local/dsh-qwen-plan-usage README · Install：Then restart DeepSeek Harness. Open **Settings → Models**, scroll to **Qwen Token Plan usage**, and choose **Sign in to Qwen Cloud**.

@local/dsh-qwen-plan-usage README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1` or later, with a Web UI profile.
- Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.
- A Qwen Cloud account with a Token Plan. An inference API key alone is not enough.

Verified on DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.3` and Windows Edge.

@local/dsh-qwen-plan-usage README · Privacy：The sign-in profile lives in `~/.dsh/qwen-plan-usage/edge-profile`. Do not share that folder. The debugger listens only on `127.0.0.1` while the window is open. Cookies are stored in the DSH credential record `qwen-plan-usage/session` and are not shown again. Sign-out deletes that record and does not delete your inference API key.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
